entities.summary: Christopher Paul Neil, better known as Mr. Swirl Face, is a Canadian teacher who was convicted of child sexual abuse. He was the subject of a highly publicized Interpol investigation of the child sexual abuse of at least 12 young boys in Vietnam, Cambodia, and Thailand, primarily owing to the Internet release of images depicting the abuse. He was arrested by Royal Thai Police in October 2007.
